steps.sub: every sign-in and alert for this user, in order

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where IPAddress in ("<ip_from_incident_1>", "<ip_from_incident_2>")
| summarize SignInCount = count() by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| order by SignInCount desc
caption: A hunting query scoped to the incident's own IP addresses — did either one touch another account?
